items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: The transcript contains no mention of 'Big Nick' or 'Nick' by the interviewee (Sam Jones). The name appears only in the interviewer's narrative about a bus driver named Nick.

ctx.x: Everybody was sleeping. So the bus driver--the guy's name was Nick. So I was standing--everybody was asleep but me. I was, you know, I was--so I was standing down in the well. You know that little well, you know--
